contea di ritrovamento: Redcar and Cleveland (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [IMP] TRAIANO AVG GER DAC PM TR [P] ; R/ [COS] V P P S P Q R [OPTIM]O PRINC

A complete silver denarius of the Roman period from the reign of Trajan (AD98-117). Obverse description: Laureate, draped bust right. Obverse inscription: [IMP] TRAIANO AVG GER DAC PM TR [P]. Reverse description: Victory standing left on shields, holding wreath and palm. Reverse inscription: [COS] V P P S P Q R [OPTIM]O PRINC.
